methodologyNotes: Products selected from the requested roster (Anker 351, Belkin BE112234-10, APC P12U2, Tripp Lite ISOBAR6ULTRA, Kasa HS300, UGREEN DigiNest Cube 65W, Amazon Basics 12-Outlet 4000J, CyberPower CSP600WSURC2, BESTEK MRJ8008). The requested "APC PE12" does not exist in APC's US lineup; the canonical 12-outlet APC surge protector is the P12U2, used instead. Independently re-verified June 2026 against manufacturer product pages (anker.com, belkin.com, apc.com, tripplite.eaton.com, tp-link.com, us.ugreen.com, cyberpowersystems.com, bestekdirect.com) and major retailers (Amazon, Walmart, Staples, Home Depot, Newegg, Best Buy). Two corrections applied: (1) UGREEN DigiNest Cube price corrected from $114.06 (an inflated Newegg third-party marketplace listing) to $66.99, the official UGREEN US MSRP (Walmart lists ~$69.99). (2) Kasa HS300 joule_rating nulled — TP-Link's official spec page publishes NO joule figure (only '500V Type 3 SPD'); the draft's 540J is unsupported and the commonly-cited 1710J is third-party/unverified, so a null is used rather than a guess. All other prices and headline specs corroborated from primary sources. Boolean specs (surge_protection, smart_wifi) are true/false; cord_length_ft is a number (feet) or null; joule_rating is a number or null; outlets and usb_ports are integers; mounting is a string. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
